name: Binance
desc: Get public Binance spot market data: prices, 24h statistics, order book, recent trades, candles and trading pairs. No API key needed.

actions.name: fetch_crypto_pair_price
actions.description: Fetch the current price of a pair (e.g. BTC/USDT)

actions.name: get_multiple_prices
actions.description: Get the latest trade prices of up to 100 Binance spot trading pairs in one call.

actions.name: get_24h_ticker
actions.description: Get 24-hour price change, high, low, volume and best bid/ask for a Binance spot trading pair.

actions.name: get_rolling_window_ticker
actions.description: Get price change, high, low and volume for a Binance spot trading pair over the last 1 minute to 7 days.

actions.name: get_average_price
actions.description: Get Binance's current average price of a spot trading pair over its short averaging window (5 minutes).

actions.name: get_order_book
actions.description: Get the current best bids and asks (order book depth) of a Binance spot trading pair.

actions.name: get_recent_trades
actions.description: Get the most recent trades of a Binance spot trading pair.

actions.name: get_candles
actions.description: Get open, high, low, close and volume candles of a Binance spot trading pair at a chosen interval.

actions.name: list_trading_pairs
actions.description: List the Binance pairs open for spot trading right now (status TRADING and spot trading allowed), optionally filtered by base or quote asset.

actions.name: get_trading_pair_rules
actions.description: Get the trading rules of a Binance spot pair: status, tick size, quantity step, minimum and maximum order size and value.
